description: Merges the Cognigy.AI contact profile of a given contact ID into a target profile, combining their data and contact IDs. Use when the same user has multiple profiles. MUTATING: Set dryRun=false to merge.

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without merging. Set to false to actually merge.

projectId.description: The project ID the profiles belong to

sourceContactId.description: A contact ID whose profile will be merged into the target (see contactIds in get_contact_profile / export_contact_profile)

targetProfileId.description: The profile ID that will receive the merged data

name: merge_contact_profiles
